verdict.rationale: Clara's own product claims 'Real-time insights that centralize and analyze all company spend' (Clara Intelligence) and 'full visibility' over expenses. Its transactions API documents near-real-time monitoring, analysis by user, team, or category, and transaction-status webhooks. However, the team and category breakdowns appear mainly as things a developer would build dashboards for, not as a documented founder-facing view, and merchant-level breakdown is not evidenced. Missing for 10: documented in-product real-time dashboard sliced by team, category and merchant; merchant-level spend breakdown; evidence of same-day posting latency; independent or hands-on corroboration.
